data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 claims SRC_006 and SRC_007 share a mechanism of comparative-directionality failure but distinguishes them by error type. However, the distinction is unstable: the stated refutation condition allows that both error types collapse to the same misparse. The target does not establish why truncation (dropping 'more than') and directional inversion (assigning premium to wrong item) are genuinely different mechanisms rather than two symptoms of the same underlying failure to correctly parse the comparative construction 'X costs $10 more than Y'.
